# Documesh

> Federated developer documentation from 47 vendors. Powered by WebMCP.

## When to use Documesh

Use Documesh when you need to:
- Search developer documentation across multiple vendors simultaneously (Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel, Kubernetes, React, PyTorch, Stripe, Sentry, Bun, Hono, OpenTelemetry, Argo CD, Helm, Flux, Cilium, and more)
- Match an error message or stack trace to the closest relevant documentation sections
- Look up vendor license and attribution information before citing documentation
- Find version-specific documentation (e.g. Kubernetes v1.32 vs v1.29)

## When NOT to use Documesh

- For vendor-specific advanced configuration (use the vendor's own docs directly)
- For non-developer documentation (general knowledge, non-technical topics)
- For vendors not in the mesh (check /vendors for the current list)

## How to integrate

Documesh exposes WebMCP tools via `document.modelContext.registerTool()`.
Any WebMCP-compatible agent can discover and call these tools when the page is open.

| Tool | When to call |
|------|-------------|
| `search_docs_across` | When the user asks about any developer documentation topic |
| `explain_error` | When the user pastes an error message or stack trace |
| `list_vendors` | When the user asks what vendors are covered or needs license info |

## API

- GET /health — Service health and snapshot date
- GET /search?q=&vendors=&limit= — Federated search
- GET /explain?error=&vendor= — Error-to-docs matching
- GET /vendors — Vendor registry
- GET /openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.0 specification
- GET /ask?q= — NLWeb natural language query

## Developer Portal

- [Developer Resources Index](https://documesh.selatan.org/resources.html): every developer resource — API docs, OpenAPI spec, MCP server, auth docs, SDK/CLI, sandbox
- [Developer Portal](https://documesh.selatan.org/developers.html): API docs, quickstart, OpenAPI spec
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://documesh.selatan.org/openapi.json): Machine-readable API specification
- [Authentication](https://documesh.selatan.org/auth.md): Auth guide (open API, no keys needed)

## Pages

- [Developer Resources](https://documesh.selatan.org/resources.html): one-page index of all API docs, OpenAPI, MCP, auth, SDK, and sandbox links
- [Home](https://documesh.selatan.org/): Overview and stats
- [App](https://documesh.selatan.org/app.html): Chat interface with WebMCP tools
- [Capabilities](https://documesh.selatan.org/capabilities.html): Tool documentation with schemas
- [WebMCP Tools](https://documesh.selatan.org/webmcp.html): Tool reference with inputSchema
- [Coverage](https://documesh.selatan.org/coverage.html): Vendors, licenses, legal exclusions
- [Submit Vendor](https://documesh.selatan.org/submit.html): Request documentation ingestion
- [About](https://documesh.selatan.org/about.html): About Documesh
- [Contact](https://documesh.selatan.org/contact.html): Contact information
- [Privacy](https://documesh.selatan.org/privacy.html): Privacy policy

## Sources

Documentation ingested from official vendor-published machine interfaces
(llms.txt, .md endpoints) or open-licensed git repositories. No scraping.
Full attribution on every response.

## Modular llms.txt per product area

- [API area](https://documesh.selatan.org/api/llms.txt): REST + MCP surface, versioning, errors, auth
- [Developers area](https://documesh.selatan.org/developers/llms.txt): portal, quickstart, rate limits, SDKs
